_comment: Sample release manifest served by tools/dev-server. Wire shape matches `UpdateManifest` in src/core/adapters/updater/manifest_verifier.ts. The `signature` field below is a placeholder — production manifests are signed by the Ed25519 key emitted by the T-L7-02 release-signing pipeline. The dev server is intended to exercise the polling + download paths; signature verification will return `signature_invalid` against this fixture (which is the documented behaviour for an unsigned dev manifest).
notes: Local dev fixture — minimal tar.gz containing version.txt = '0.0.1'. Regenerate via `node tools/dev-server/_gen-fixture.mjs` after editing fixture contents; copy the printed sha256 into this file.
